        <script><![CDATA[/**
 * Safety Stock Guard — Before-save BR on Inventory Stock
 *
 * Blocks stock deductions that would push available_quantity below
 * safety_stock UNLESS the triggering Inventory Request has
 * priority = critical or high.
 *
 * Runs at order 150 (AFTER "Calculate Available Qty" at order 100).
 * Only fires on UPDATE when total_quantity is being REDUCED.
 *
 * Does NOT block:
 *  - Stock increases (receipts, destination-side of transfers)
 *  - Inserts (new stock records)
 *  - Changes that keep projected available >= safety_stock
 *  - Critical or high priority request deductions
 *  - Deductions with no traceable request (default-allow)
 */
(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    // Only act on deductions (total_quantity being reduced)
    var newTotal = parseFloat(current.getValue('total_quantity')) || 0;
    var oldTotal = parseFloat(previous.getValue('total_quantity')) || 0;

    if (newTotal >= oldTotal) {
        // Not a deduction — stock is increasing or unchanged. Allow.
        return;
    }

    // Calculate projected available after this deduction
    var reservedQty = parseFloat(current.getValue('reserved_quantity')) || 0;
    var projectedAvailable = newTotal - reservedQty;
    var safetyStock = parseFloat(current.getValue('safety_stock')) || 0;

    // If safety_stock is zero or not set, no threshold to enforce
    if (safetyStock <= 0) {
        return;
    }

    // If projected available stays at or above safety stock, allow
    if (projectedAvailable >= safetyStock) {
        return;
    }

    // --- Projected available BELOW safety stock ---
    // Find the triggering Inventory Request to check priority
    var stockSysId = current.getUniqueValue();
    var req = new GlideRecord('x_2056099_indust_0_inv_req');
    req.addQuery('related_inventory_stock', stockSysId);
    req.addQuery('status', 'in_progress');
    req.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
    req.setLimit(1);
    req.query();

    if (!req.next()) {
        // No in_progress request found for this stock.
        // Default-allow: this may be an admin adjustment or
        // automation without a request context.
        // The Safety Stock Monitoring flow will still create
        // an alert after the save completes.
        return;
    }

    var priority = req.getValue('priority');

    // Critical and high priority requests override the safety stock guard
    if (priority === 'critical' || priority === 'high') {
        // Allow — the existing Safety Stock Monitoring flow
        // will create a below_safety_stock alert after this save.
        return;
    }

    // Medium and low priority requests are BLOCKED
    gs.addErrorMessage(
        'Stock update blocked: This deduction would reduce available stock (' +
        projectedAvailable.toFixed(2) +
        ') below the safety stock threshold (' +
        safetyStock.toFixed(2) +
        '). Request ' + req.getValue('number') +
        ' has priority "' + priority +
        '". Only critical or high priority requests can proceed. ' +
        'Please escalate the request priority or replenish stock first.'
    );
    current.setAbortAction(true);
})(current, previous);
]]></script>
